content.user_title: Discover YouTube Channels with Structured Data
content.value_statement: Finding relevant YouTube creators manually takes time and produces inconsistent records. This skill searches through BrowserAct and returns structured channel details.
actual_capabilities: Starts a predefined BrowserAct workflow for a YouTube channel keyword search.
Accepts an optional upload date filter, with Any time as the default.
Polls task status every ten seconds for up to five minutes.
Returns channel names, links, handles, verification status, subscribers, descriptions, and thumbnails when available.
Reports connection, authorization, task failure, and timeout conditions.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct account and BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Sends search terms to the BrowserAct service and depends on its availability.
Supports only keyword and upload date inputs exposed by the predefined workflow.
May take several minutes and stops polling after five minutes.

use_cases.title: Build a creator shortlist
use_cases.description: Find active channels in a campaign niche and compare available audience details.

use_cases.title: Map competing channels
use_cases.description: Collect channels related to products, topics, or competing brands for landscape research.

use_cases.title: Source expert channels
use_cases.description: Discover relevant channels for partnerships, interviews, or content monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Find channels by topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Find YouTube channels about [topic] with the upload date set to Any time. Summarize the available channel details.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a broad channel list.

prompt_templates.title: Find recently active creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for YouTube channels about [topic] that published within [upload date]. Highlight verified channels and subscriber counts.
prompt_templates.scenario: A campaign planner needs active creators.

prompt_templates.title: Research a competitive niche
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for channels related to [niche or competitor]. Group the results by audience size and note relevant descriptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: A researcher is mapping a competitive landscape.

prompt_templates.title: Create an outreach shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find channels for [campaign theme] using [upload date]. Rank suitable outreach candidates using verification, subscribers, descriptions, and recent activity.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a prioritized creator shortlist.

output_examples.input: Find channels about home automation with uploads this week.
output_examples.output: The result lists matching channel names, links, handles, subscriber counts, verification status, descriptions, and thumbnail links.

output_examples.input: Research YouTube channels covering sustainable packaging.
output: Channel: Circular Design Weekly, with its handle and channel link.
Audience: The available subscriber count and verification status.
Profile: A short channel description and thumbnail link.

output_examples.input: Find active cybersecurity education channels for outreach.
output_examples.output: A prioritized summary identifies relevant channels and compares available audience, verification, profile, and activity information.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through a local environment or approved secret manager.
Use focused keywords and an upload date that matches the research objective.
Review channel links and current metrics before making outreach or investment decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, messages, command arguments, or saved output.
Do not treat subscriber counts or verification status as proof of audience quality.
Do not retry authorization failures without correcting the credential.

faq.question: What credential does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a BrowserAct API key configured as BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment.

faq.question: Should I provide my API key in chat?
faq.answer: No. Configure the key through a local environment or an approved secret manager.

faq.question: What search filters are supported?
faq.answer: The script accepts search keywords and an optional upload date value.

faq.question: How long can a search take?
faq.answer: The script polls for up to five minutes and reports status every ten seconds.

faq.question: Which channel fields can be returned?
faq.answer: Results can include title, link, handle, verification status, subscribers, description, and thumbnail.

faq.question: What happens when the task fails?
faq.answer: The script reports connection, task, retrieval, or timeout errors. The skill documentation allows one retry for non-authorization failures.
